newsitem.title: CANADA: Golden Rule rises after presentation.
newsitem.headline: Golden Rule rises after presentation.

text.p: Shares in Golden Rule Resources Ltd took another leap on Wednesday in heavy trading after company executives made a presentation to analysts on Tuesday.
Shares in the Calgary-based gold exploration company were up C$2 to C$12.90 with more than one million shares changing hands in the first hour of trading on Wednesday.
The stock began shooting up after the company released trenching results from its exploration property in Ghana in early January. Golden Rule was trading around C$5.25 on January 6.

Golden Rule's partner on the Stenpad property in Ghana, Hixon Gold Resources Inc, hit a new high on Wednesday morning, rising to C$10.80 before settling at C$10.45 in early trading, up C$0.85 on the day.
